description: Canonical JTWP moderation categories selected by an admin during case review. If no category fits, OTHER/UNCATEGORIZED may be used without invalidating the moderation action.

HATE_SPEECH.label: Hate Speech / Discrimination
HATE_SPEECH.description: Racism, slurs, hate speech, discriminatory harassment, or identity-based targeting.

HARASSMENT.label: Harassment / Bullying
HARASSMENT.description: Bullying, targeted harassment, intimidation, threats, or repeated abusive conduct.

CONDUCT.label: General Conduct / Respect
CONDUCT.description: General disrespectful or disruptive behavior that does not fit a more specific category.

GAMEPLAY.label: Gameplay Misconduct
GAMEPLAY.description: Intentional team killing, griefing, or other prohibited gameplay behavior.

SERVER_INTEGRITY.label: Server Integrity / Performance
SERVER_INTEGRITY.description: Behavior intended to degrade, crash, overload, or destabilize the server.

PRIVACY.label: Privacy / Personal Information
PRIVACY.description: Doxxing, disclosure of private information, or threats involving private information.

CHEATING.label: Cheating / Unfair Software
CHEATING.description: External software, cheats, unauthorized modifications, automation, or similar unfair advantages.

EXPLICIT_CONTENT.label: Explicit / Graphic Content
EXPLICIT_CONTENT.description: Pornographic, sexually explicit, or graphic real-world gore content.

EXPLOITING.label: Exploiting / Game-Mode Manipulation
EXPLOITING.description: Abusing bugs, game-mode systems, or unintended mechanics for an unfair advantage.

DISRUPTION.label: Disruption / Griefing
DISRUPTION.description: Deliberately interfering with other players' ability to enjoy or use the server.

COMMUNICATION.label: Spam / Communication Abuse
COMMUNICATION.description: Message spam, microphone spam, command spam, or similar deliberate communication disruption.

OTHER.label: Other / Uncategorized
OTHER.description: Use when the conduct appears punishable but no existing category or rule adequately describes it. This does not invalidate the case or punishment; it flags a rules gap for later review.
